scope: Twenty-independent-episode WorldArena BWM counterfactual diagnostic preparation
summary: A pinned five-task, 100-physical-episode WorldArena cache was downloaded and compiled into task-disjoint BWM data; a compact 20-episode wipe_table transfer bundle and 20 lineage-safe factual/action-swap pairs are ready on a800-1.
evidence: The source cache contains 300 verified files and 721,819,835 bytes at revision af1ac34d3881f84096345542c631fbb1b9540d50.
The compiled split contains 60 train, 20 validation, and 20 test physical episodes.
Eighty source videos contain one terminal frame beyond the HDF5 action length; the compiler now excludes only that sentinel and keeps every selected 57-frame window inside the aligned prefix.
The compact BWM test bundle contains 20 independent wipe_table episodes in 937,316 payload bytes.
The history-preserving counterfactual suite contains 20 independent physical groups and 40 factual/swapped rows.
lessons: Full raw video transfer was unnecessary; deterministic 57-frame materialization reduced the claim-equivalent test payload below one megabyte.
Counterfactual compilation must slice each variable-length action episode to its declared 57-frame intervention window.
limitations: Swapped futures still lack executable physical references and remain an action-sensitivity diagnostic.
The matched BWM GPU run is queued because all compatible a800-1 GPUs are occupied by other users.
next_actions: Let the persisted GPU watcher launch official BWM and the promoted adapter on GPUs 1 and 4 when both exceed 61,000 MiB free, then run the frozen 20-episode evaluator.
